selected_scope.title: LC Office V81 Integration
selected_scope.finding: S1.42AJ was built from exact accepted S1.42AI and passed the static gate. The exported delta is exactly the three LC Office additions plus DungeonGenerationPlus 1.5.0 -> 1.5.1; every other package block and every non-export profile member is unchanged, IAmBatby LLL 1.7.12 remains the sole LLL owner, the deprecated fork is absent, and the accepted Interior Weight Normalization DLL is byte-identical. The first full-normal S1.42AJ runtime evidence is ingested at RuntimeEvidence/S1.42AJ/20260917T171109Z/ (LogOutput.log SHA-256 b5267cd62a222929c117bae52371229d4fe0dcf510248ee80d1f4c1a51e67c12). On Offense, modern LLL returned LC Office as viable at author rarity 65 and the accepted Interior Weight Normalization produced final effective LC Office(100); the run selected Facility, so actual LC Office generation/traversal/elevator/power/enemy-navigation coverage remains outstanding. S1.42AJ-DIAG1 is published from the exact reviewed CI artifact, statically verified, and is now the armed runtime-evidence target for only the missing LC Office generation coverage. Balanced S1.42AJ remains unchanged, not accepted, and the lifecycle candidate.
selected_scope.analysis_contract: Preserve the ingested S1.42AJ full-normal proof: exact modern IAmBatby LLL ownership, LC Office viable on Offense at author rarity 65, and final effective rarity 100. Use the already published strictly diagnostic S1.42AJ-DIAG1 derived from exact S1.42AJ only to obtain missing generation coverage: it force-selects LC Office on Offense after normal viability determination; validate actual generation/traversal, elevator and breaker/power where available, enemy navigation, scrap generation, inherited accepted contracts, and no new critical regression/error flood. The diagnostic must not alter or replace balanced S1.42AJ and must not introduce universal-moon availability or another deferred Interior scope.
selected_scope.next_action: Runtime-test the activated S1.42AJ-DIAG1 diagnostic artifact on Offense for only the missing LC Office generation coverage: confirm LC Office actually generates after normal viability, validate traversal/entrance/exit, elevator and breaker/power where available, enemy navigation, scrap generation, and absence of a new critical regression/error flood. Preserve the existing unforced S1.42AJ viability/weight proof and do not treat diagnostic force-selection as balanced selection semantics. Runtime evidence must be uploaded under S1.42AJ-DIAG1 via RuntimeInbox/ACTIVE_BUILD.txt.
